overview: White develops the bishop to d3 against the 2...d6 Sicilian and aims for a set-up with c3 or Nc3 and Be3, avoiding the Open Sicilian. Black usually plays ...Nf6 and ...Nc6 with a flexible game. It is a quiet anti-Sicilian with little forcing theory; I am not certain of the exact set-up.

white_ideas.idea: Build a quiet set-up with Bd3, c3 or Nc3 and O-O
Control the centre with e4 and later d4

black_ideas.idea: Counter on the queenside and in the centre

typical_structures.structure: Sicilian with e4 against d6/c5 pawns

character.notes: Quiet set-ups with no early forcing play.

structure.notes: Sicilian asymmetry with a half-open c-file for Black.
